scope: Primary-source nullspace/feature-logit overlap audit for candidate48, not exhaustive novelty verification

papers.title: Outlier Detection through Null Space Analysis of Neural Networks
papers.authors: Matthew Cook; Alina Zare; Paul Gader
papers.metadata_provenance: Paper Search matched exact title and version, download_arxiv exact version
papers.reviewed: Abstract and3 Outlier Detection with Null Space Analysis, equations7/8 and inference Algorithm1. Layer projection magnitudes enter training regularization and an outlier test statistic.
papers.overlap: Nullspace feature components, their magnitudes and abnormal-input detection are explicit prior art. Nullspace decomposition alone is not a contribution.
papers.candidate_difference_and_limit: Candidate48 holds detector weights fixed, uses the vector nullspace component as a supervised linear foreground feature, and compares against all logits/rowspace/shuffled controls. It neither reproduces NuSA training nor defines its FP rows as OOD; the task difference alone does not prove novelty.

papers.title: ViM: Out-Of-Distribution with Virtual-logit Matching
papers.authors: Haoqi Wang; Zhizhong Li; Litong Feng; Wayne Zhang
papers.metadata_provenance: Paper Search exact-title search, download_arxiv exact version
papers.reviewed: 3 Motivation: The Missing Info in Logits, NuSA/principal-space comparison,4 Virtual-logit Matching and equations4--6. Principal-space residual, training-fitted scaling and original logits are combined into a virtual-class score.
papers.overlap: Information lost when projecting features to class logits and combining remaining feature evidence with logits are explicitly established. ViM's principal residual is not identical to the final W nullspace.
papers.candidate_difference_and_limit: Candidate48 tests conditional foreground discrimination with fixed128-dimensional W-null components and a convex linear residual, no principal-rank selection or virtual-class norm. This is a feasibility control, not a new OOD method or a full ViM reproduction.

result_boundary: Candidate48 numerical fits converge, but tiny null-feature NLL.385243 is worse than logits-only.384291 and shuffled-null.384757; AUROC is also worse. No inference/AP/novelty promotion.
